iPhone 18 Pro Wait Times Fall 31%, Says Munster
The analyst also shared a blog post in which he said delivery lead times for the iPhone 18 Pro were now 31% shorter than those for the
iPhone 17 Pro
at the same point last year. Meanwhile, Pro Max lead times remained 1% longer year over year.
At launch, the Pro and Pro Max had lead times 15% and 18% longer than their respective predecessors, according to Munster’s tracking across eight countries.

children: iPhone Duo Preorders Could Offer a Clearer Signal
Preorders for the iPhone Duo open Oct. 16, with shipments set to begin Oct. 23.

“The wild card is the Duo, which I continue to believe will surprise to the upside. For the first year, I expect units of close to 20m, compared to current estimates that call for around 10m,” Munster said.
However, he cautioned that initial supply constraints could push delivery wait times to five weeks during the first month, making early demand harder to assess.

The combined iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max lead times averaged 3% longer than last year’s models over the first three weeks. Munster said the recent decline could limit expectations for additional upside in the December quarter.
